integrity: The result is an exact analytical finite-horizon statement. Numerical tests are supporting diagnostics, and literature comparisons retain explicit residual risks.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite horizon on real positive-definite quadratics, predetermined positive step multiset, independent zero-mean gradient errors with common covariance; no claim for nonquadratic objectives, variable/state-dependent covariances, floating-point arithmetic, or bounded intermediate transients.
title: Descending spectral steps minimize every terminal quadratic noise risk
